notes.title: inSynch's going full mobile on Jan 21st!
notes.content:
When we put the game on Greenlight, a lot of our supporters asked for a mobile version.
At the time we didn't even know if the game would interest enough people for the PC, Mac, and Linux versions to be released on Steam.

A year later, we are very proud to announce that the iOS and Android versions will be live next week!

Stay tuned, we will make another announcement with further details next week :)

Thank you everyone, and thanks to all the new players who joined us during the Winter Sales!

- Them Games

notes.title: (update) Groupees Build a Greenlight 7
notes.content:
Dear all!

We've reached Groupees and we are figuring out how to send you the Steam keys.

We apologize for the delay, as Groupees cannot provide us the full mailing list of buyers, you know, privacy and all, we cannot send the keys directly from us to you (with love)

Everything should be sent soon enough, thank you for your patience and above all, for coming to us in the first place!

Do not hesitate to ask us questions here, we check the Community Hub several times per day!

(update): The keys have been sent to Groupees. From now on, we entrust Groupees with the fair distribution of our supporters' keys. We have no responsibilities in the distribution of said keys.

Thank you for your patience and support!
